name: Toggle button
description: A button that stays pressed or not pressed, such as Bold in a text editor or Mute in a video player. For a setting that is on or off, use a Switch.
summary: Button that stays pressed until pressed again
researchNote: A pressed-state button, not a setting

elements.name: Label
elements.description: Names the action; stays the same in both states. Can be visually hidden on icon-only buttons

elements.name: Pressed style
elements.description: Filled background or border that marks the pressed state

elements.name: Icon
elements.description: Leading icon, or the only visible content

configOptions.options: Text, Icon only, Icon and text

variants.caption: Icon only — not pressed and pressed
Group — independent toggles side by side

usageNotes: Keep the label the same in both states and let aria-pressed carry the state. If the label changes, as with Play and Pause, drop aria-pressed; the ARIA Authoring Practices advise against changing both.
Use a Toggle button for a pressed state in an editor or player. For a setting that is on or off, use a Switch. For one choice among several, use a Segmented control.
Show the pressed state with more than color, such as a filled background plus a border (WCAG 1.4.1, 1.4.11).
Icon-only toggle buttons need an accessible name, such as aria-label="Bold".
In a group, each toggle button keeps its own aria-pressed and can be pressed independently.
frameworkNotes: 'Toggle' means a switch in Carbon and Atlassian, and a pressed button in shadcn/ui.
